hypothesis: Can duration—not movement—become the primary gesture of an interface?
interaction: Press and hold with pointer, touch, Enter, or Space. Duration changes typographic spacing and visual pressure. Release records a session-only measure and optionally produces a user-initiated tone.
performance: No external assets or runtime dependencies; one animation-frame loop runs only during a hold.
self_critique: The mapping is coherent, but deformation uses letter spacing and scale rather than a true variable-font axis.
